mapper.select: select * from mall_cart_item where user_id = #{userId} and sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_cart_item (user_id, product_id, sku_id, number, selected, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{number}, 1, now(), now()) on duplicate key update number = least(number + values(number), #{stock}), product_id = values(product_id), selected = 1, update_time = now()
mapper.update: update mall_cart_item ci join mall_sku s on s.id = ci.sku_id and s.product_id = ci.product_id join mall_product p on p.id = ci.product_id set ci.selected = #{selected}, ci.update_time = now() where ci.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = 1 and s.status = 1 and s.stock > 0
mapper.delete: delete from mall_cart_item where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}

delete ci from mall_cart_item ci left join mall_product p on p.id = ci.product_id left join mall_sku s on s.id = ci.sku_id and s.product_id = ci.product_id where ci.user_id = #{userId} and (p.id is null or p.status <> 1 or s.id is null or s.status <> 1 or s.stock <= 0)
mapper.select: select count(*) from mall_cart_item where user_id = #{userId}

select count(*) from mall_cart_item ci left join mall_product p on p.id = ci.product_id left join mall_sku s on s.id = ci.sku_id and s.product_id = ci.product_id where ci.user_id = #{userId} and (p.id is null or p.status <> 1 or s.id is null or s.status <> 1 or s.stock <= 0)

select ci.id, ci.product_id as productId, ci.sku_id as skuId, ci.number, ci.selected, ci.create_time as createTime, ci.update_time as updateTime, p.name as productName, p.subtitle, p.status as productStatus, s.status as skuStatus, s.sku_code as skuCode, s.price, s.stock, coalesce(s.image, p.main_image) as image, (select group_concat(sv.value order by sp.sort separator ' / ') from mall_sku_spec ss join mall_spec sp on sp.id = ss.spec_id join mall_spec_value sv on sv.id = ss.spec_value_id where ss.sku_id = ci.sku_id) as specText from mall_cart_item ci left join mall_product p on p.id = ci.product_id left join mall_sku s on s.id = ci.sku_id and s.product_id = ci.product_id where ci.user_id = #{userId} order by ci.update_time desc, ci.id desc

select ci.id, ci.product_id as productId, ci.sku_id as skuId, ci.number, ci.selected, ci.create_time as createTime, ci.update_time as updateTime, p.name as productName, p.subtitle, p.status as productStatus, s.status as skuStatus, s.sku_code as skuCode, s.price, s.stock, coalesce(s.image, p.main_image) as image, (select group_concat(sv.value order by sp.sort separator ' / ') from mall_sku_spec ss join mall_spec sp on sp.id = ss.spec_id join mall_spec_value sv on sv.id = ss.spec_value_id where ss.sku_id = ci.sku_id) as specText from mall_cart_item ci left join mall_product p on p.id = ci.product_id left join mall_sku s on s.id = ci.sku_id and s.product_id = ci.product_id where ci.user_id = #{userId} and ci.selected = 1 order by ci.update_time desc, ci.id desc
